notes.title: Join the beta of the latest version of Boom 3D!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We're working on the latest version of Boom 3D and we've released a beta to hear your feedback and suggestions. Follow the simple steps below to be a part of the test:

- Visit the store
- Right click ‘Boom 3D’
- Select 'Properties’
- Click ‘Betas’
- From the dropdown, click ‘beta - Boom 3D Beta’

We're all ears, and would really, really appreciate your feedback and suggestions. Here's where you can list them out.

Cheers,
Team Boom 3D

notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Hope you are all safe and well!

We have an update for you, and here's what's new:New and improved wave slider
Improved audio output quality 

In addition to this we have made some minor bug fixes and performance improvements, enjoy! :) 

What would you like to see as a new feature in Boom 3D?

We're always on the lookout for requests from you guys, so please comment here or write to us with your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Here's what's new:

• You can now select the output device from the tray menu!
• We have added the option to disable auto-switching of the output device.
• There is now a dedicated volume controller just for the Boom player!
• Boom 3D has been localized in Portuguese and Russian.

In addition to this we have made some minor bug fixes and performance improvements, enjoy! :) 

We're always on the lookout for feature requests from you guys, so please write to us with your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Here's what's new:

- Vastly improved the ’Night Mode’
- Performance improvements and enhancements.
- Bug fixes.

And we got rid of those pesky bugs! If you still find one of them running around, please let us know ;)

notes.title: Minor update!
notes.notes:
What's new?

Minor fixes
Performance enhancements


We also got rid of some pesky bugs! If you find any more of them running around, please write to us at boomwindows@globaldelight.com

notes.title: Major Update News!
notes.notes:
Hello Boomers!
We really hope you're enjoying using Boom 3D and we would like to share some great news with you! In preparation for the new year, we have added exciting new features to the app:

Access to 20,000+ Internet Radio Stations! Enjoy free access to more than 20k local and international Radio stations across 120 countries.

A State of the Art Audio Player! Play your locally stored songs with unbeatable Boom effects with our full-fledged audio player and create playlists to organize your music collections just like your personal music player app.


Go ahead and check it out, and don't forget to give us your feedback!

Until next time, keep BOOMin! ;)
